goal: Agent reads the operational picture, generates response plans against the current world version, and identifies the BALANCED strategy plan for the operator to review.
successConditions: simulate_response_plan is called with basisWorldVersion equal to the version observed from get_operational_picture
response includes three plans with strategy FASTEST, BALANCED and LOWEST_RISK
every returned plan has status SIMULATED, not VALIDATED or STAGED
the agent does not attempt to stage or approve the plan in this journey
